title: Louisiana hunting licenses and WMA access
intro: A Basic Hunting License is required for most hunters. Deer, turkey, and waterfowl need additional licenses. A WMA Access Permit is required on LDWF WMAs/refuges (ages 18+). Confirm fees at LDWF before you buy.

whereToBuy.title: Online
whereToBuy.body: Buy licenses and WMA access at https://louisianaoutdoors.com/.

whereToBuy.title: License vendor
whereToBuy.body: Authorized vendors sell hunting licenses statewide.

whereToBuy.title: WMA lottery hunts
whereToBuy.body: Deer, turkey, dove, waterfowl, and other lottery hunts are applied for through LDWF’s lottery system.

whereToBuy.title: Over the counter / self-clearing
whereToBuy.body: Many WMA hunts are open with self-clearing permits during published seasons; lotteries are separate.

whereToBuy.title: Corps of Engineers lakes
whereToBuy.body: Some USACE projects require a separate lake/Recreation.gov permit in addition to LDWF licenses.

deadlines.name: License validity
deadlines.detail: Licenses are valid 365 days from purchase.

deadlines.name: WMA lottery applications
deadlines.detail: Windows vary by hunt — check LDWF lottery listings.
